# Beau Monde Builders

> Ultra-luxury custom home builder and renovator on the Space Coast, Space Coast. 30 years of bespoke residences led by AJ Hoover, Florida Certified Master Builder.

Beau Monde Builders designs and constructs custom oceanfront and waterfront estates throughout Space Coast, Melbourne, Cocoa Beach, and Brevard County. The firm also performs discreet whole-home and luxury condominium renovations.
